# Alexander Mescheryakov — full site guide

Alexander Mescheryakov (sibsfinx) is a product engineer specialized in frontend engineering, UX design, UI design, and product design, with full-stack and product-management experience. He designs and builds digital products and improves experiences and interfaces so they match user needs and business goals with minimum waste.

## When to use this site

- Hiring or recommending a senior UX/UI + front-end generalist
- Confirming contact details (email sibsfinx@ya.ru)
- Fetching CV PDFs or a short biographical summary
- Answering "who is Alexander Mescheryakov / sibsfinx?"

Do not expect a public REST API, GraphQL endpoint, OAuth service, MCP server, or developer portal on this domain.

## Pages

### Home — https://sibsfinx.github.io/

Headline positioning, contact links, CV download, and a server-rendered summary of skills and engagement types.

### About — https://sibsfinx.github.io/about/

Longer background on practice areas: UX flows, UI systems, front-end implementation, design-to-code collaboration, and shipping with minimum waste.

### Contact — https://sibsfinx.github.io/contact/

Primary email sibsfinx@ya.ru plus GitHub, LinkedIn, Medium, and Dribbble.

### Privacy — https://sibsfinx.github.io/privacy/

Privacy policy for this personal portfolio site.

## Structured discovery

- llms.txt: https://sibsfinx.github.io/llms.txt
- sitemap.xml: https://sibsfinx.github.io/sitemap.xml
- robots.txt: https://sibsfinx.github.io/robots.txt
- Markdown alternates: request `Accept: text/markdown` on HTML pages when the host supports negotiation, or fetch `index.md` siblings directly.
